1778-2921-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Memnite is starting in your graveyard.
1778-2921-5006-8170.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Memnite spell. Then, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Memnite, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

5078-5642-5705.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability and Echoes of Eternity trigger.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Echoes of Eternity trigger, creating a copy of the Sensei's Divining Top spell.
Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

4279-6026-6273--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6026-6273--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant, Field of Souls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Field of Souls ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2645-3430-3478-4348.easyPrerequisites: Ley Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-3478-4348.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ley Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2645-2930-3257-3430.easyPrerequisites: Portent Tracker doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-2930-3257-3430.description:
Activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping Rakdos Carnarium
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Portent Tracker.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

339-647-677-6495.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4050-7084-7893.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1770-2060-2762-6792.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters, Mm'menon triggers twice due to Elesh Norn, putting a +1/+1 counter on Thopter Squadron and Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3641-5641-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3641-5641-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4742-7353.easyPrerequisites: Opponents have at least two creature cards in their graveyards.
3259-4742-7353.notablePrerequisites: Opponents with creature cards in their graveyards cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4742-7353.description:
Deal combat damage using Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached. Shark Shredder and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Shark Shredder trigger, putting a creature card from the defending player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4742-7353.notes: If there happens to be two or more creatures with haste in opponents' graveyards, you can omit Nahiri's Resolve so long as both Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached do not have summoning sickness.

338-4659-5086-5183-6441.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-4659-5086-5183-6441.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

465-3742-4251-4875-6965.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

862-2173-5147-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1497-2173-5220-6634.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2173-5073-5220-5933.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

585-4508-5880-6753.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

586-2438-4924-5258-5618.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

465-618-997.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token.
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3967-4336-5220-5683.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Kobolds of Kher Keep and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1283-2034-2820-5006.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lurrus, adding {C}{C}.
When Lurrus dies, Angelic Renewal triggers, causing you to sacrifice Angelic Renewal and return Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Angelic Renewal from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Repeat.

2-2034-2557-5554.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Gnomes, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

539-4385-4552-4893.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {0}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Repeat.

337-934-3525-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other artifact.
Pemmin's Aura and Amorphous Axe attached to Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Embraal Gear-Smasher does not have summoning sickness.
337-934-3525-4508.description:
Activate Embraal Gear-Smasher by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token for each opponent dealt damage by Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Repeat.

57-283-1537-4747.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Feldon.
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
57-283-1537-4747.description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Zealous Conscripts.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability, targeting Alena.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Alena with haste.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 1, creating a token copy of Zealous Conscripts with haste.
The token Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, untapping Feldon.
Activate the token Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

11-223-4289-4872.notablePrerequisites: Kalamax does not have summoning sickness.
11-223-4289-4872.description:
Activate Kalamax by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Time Warp.
Kalamax first and second abilities triggers.
Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Narset's Reversal, targeting the first Narset's Reversal.
Resolve Kalamax's second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, returning it to your hand and choosing Time Warp for the copy.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal, returning Time Warp to your hand and taking an extra turn after this one.
Pass to next turn.
Repeat.

2174-3147-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Juniper Order Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Juniper Order Druid.
2174-3147-3525.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Repeat any number of times.
